Why now

The world of work
is shifting fast.

AI is replacing entire categories of jobs. A new generation of professionals - builders, founders, freelancers, project contributors - chooses to move independently rather than fill roles that will soon be automated.

At the same time, companies are sitting on unsolved problems and can't find the right people. Not through LinkedIn. Not through job boards. They need talent that's relevant, nearby, and ready.

Зоnd was built for exactly this intersection.

85M
jobs estimated to be displaced by AI by 2025 (WEF)
97M
new roles emerging in the human-AI economy
73%
of Gen Z prefer project-based work over traditional employment
1st
proximity-first professional network built for the new era
Who it's for

Three sides of
the same network.

Зоnd brings together the people, companies, and industries that need to find each other - without the noise.

🚀

Independent talent

Builders, freelancers, and project contributors who want to work on their own terms - without competing for roles AI will replace.

  • Discover company challenges that match your skills
  • Find co-founders and collaborators nearby
  • Build your audio profile - let your voice do the intro
  • Build reputation in your industry sector
🏢

Companies with challenges

Organizations that have specific problems to solve and need the right people - not just candidates, but contributors who understand the domain.

  • Post a challenge card, not a job listing
  • Find professionals in your industry and region
  • Hear their audio profile before you connect
  • Discover talent before they're on the market
🌐

Industry connectors

People and organizations at the intersection of sectors - accelerators, NGOs, ecosystem builders - who move resources to where they're needed.

  • See who's active in your sector nearby
  • Join live rooms to take the pulse of an industry
  • Connect ecosystem players in real time
  • Build density in your industry cluster
How it works

Simple by design.
Powerful by proximity.

1

Join your sector

Create an audio profile and join your industry vertical. Record your 60-second voice intro - the one that actually says what you want to work on.

2

Discover what's around you

The radar shows who's nearby. Browse audio profiles, jump into a live room, or find company challenge cards that match your skills.

3

Connect and move fast

Swipe to connect when there's a match. Start a direct chat, join a live room, or respond to a company challenge - all in the same app.

Where we started

Built for sectors
with real stakes.

We didn't launch everywhere. We went deep into two sectors that needed this most: Agriculture and Social impact. More verticals coming - with the same focused approach.

🌾 Agro & Food

Where land meets talent and technology

AgTech founders, agronomists, farm owners, food producers, and investors - all in one proximity network, organized by region and specialization.
